{{Top}}
{{Quote|Good. It would be unfortunate if I had to leave a garrison here.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:TCG_Garrison_at_Tatooine_by_Chase_Toole.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial garrison unit on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
[[File:Endor_AT-ST_PTA.png|thumb|right|250px|AT-STs patrol the garrison base on Endor]]
'''Garrison''' was a collective term for a body of [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed in a particular location, originally to guard it, but then often simply using it as a home base. Garrison units were usually immobile, unless stationed on a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. In many instances, garrisons were used to keep a local population in line. A large presence of troops in a garrison in the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] cowed the indigenous people.

The Galactic Empire had several models of [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison bases]].
